projects.name: AI Database Query Assistant
bullets: Built an AI-powered Text-to-SQL application to convert natural language questions into accurate SQL queries.
Used SQLAlchemy to automatically read database tables and columns, and added self-correction logic to automatically fix failed SQL queries.
Implemented safety checks using sqlglot to block harmful commands (like DROP and DELETE), and created a clean Streamlit interface with interactive tables and charts.

projects.name: Online Book Store Application
bullets: Developed a full-stack online bookstore application using React, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB.
Implemented secure JWT-based user authentication with Sign Up and Login functionality.
Built features for browsing and managing books with real-time data updates.
Designed a responsive and modern user interface using Tailwind CSS for seamless experience across devices.
Integrated shopping cart functionality and connected frontend with backend APIs using Axios.

projects.name: Movie Recommender App
bullets: Built a content-based movie recommendation system using Python.
Used cosine similarity to recommend movies based on movie metadata.
Integrated TMDB API to display movie posters, ratings, and details.
Added advanced filtering options including genre, release year, and rating for improved user experience.

Developed and optimized reusable frontend components, responsive service sections, and contact forms for the official website using React, Tailwind CSS, and JavaScript, ensuring cross-device compatibility and improved user engagement.
